fields.label: About
fields.options: Unofficial, QR-linked WhatsApp integration — not the official WhatsApp Business Platform, and not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Don't have an account? Create a Tarceel account.

fields.description: Tarceel API base URL. Leave as the production default unless testing against a non-production Tarceel deployment.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The Tarceel instance ID this site sends through (from the Tarceel dashboard).
fields.label: Instance ID

fields.description: The instance's own API key (starts with sk_). Shown once in the Tarceel dashboard; stored encrypted here.
fields.label: Instance API Key

fields.description: Let Tarceel send delivery-status updates back to this site. Use the Configure Webhook button to register this site's endpoint and store the signing secret.
fields.label: Webhook (Delivery Status)

fields.description: The endpoint registered with Tarceel. Set by the Configure Webhook button.
fields.label: Webhook URL

fields.description: Signing secret returned by Tarceel; used to verify incoming webhooks. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Map a DocType to the fieldname holding its phone number. The Send WhatsApp dialog pre-fills the recipient from this field when opened on that DocType.
fields.label: Phone Field Mappings

fields.description: Set once the default ERPNext phone mappings and sample templates have been seeded, so they are not re-created (respecting any you delete).
fields.label: Default Data Seeded
